Senses.Explanation: Stick-blows and shouts names the paired encounter actions of striking with a staff and shouting. Records describe teachers using them, students receiving them, and later speakers appraising reliance on them as a recognizable way. The compound can summarize a style even where a stored sentence does not narrate a fresh blow or shout. These are deployments of one paired action-set rather than separate senses.
Senses.Note: The frozen corpus has 1,087 exact hits in 252 files representing 249 works. Ten standalone anchors span direct use, instruction, retrospective description, stylistic appraisal, and criticism across independent works; a legacy witness lacking the exact headword was rejected.

Occurrences.Kwic: 德山入門便棒臨濟入門便喝不動棒喝還有為人處也無
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Yulin Tongxiu's complete evening interview: an unnamed monk asks whether Deshan and Linji have a place for people without moving stick or shout. Yulin is respondent, not utterer.

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: 問德山入門便棒…不動棒喝還有為人處也無 assigns the compound to the monk's question; Yulin answers only with 有.
ActorAttribution.ReviewedBy: Codex cohorts 1-3 v6 full-case hand read

Occurrences.Kwic: 德山、臨濟，棒喝交馳，機鋒掣電，令你捫摸不入、插足不得
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Huangbo Wunian Shenyou, in Huangbo Wunian's Further Questions (黃蘗無念禪師復問), pairs Deshan and Linji with blows and shouts flying back and forth, leaving no finger-hold or foot-hold.

Occurrences.Kwic: 問：「德山棒、臨濟喝，除此二途，有何指示？」師打云：「喚作棒喝，入地獄如箭。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Fushi Tongxian's complete opening interview: an unnamed monk asks what indication exists beyond Deshan's stick and Linji's shout. Fushi is respondent, not utterer.

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: 問：德山棒、臨濟喝，除此二途… places the compound in the monk's question; Fushi answers and strikes afterward.
ActorAttribution.ReviewedBy: Codex cohorts 1-3 v6 full-case hand read

Occurrences.Kwic: 近時有一等拍盲禪者，高談臨濟專事棒喝，離此別無長處
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Xueguan Zhiyin, in the Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Xueguan (雪關禪師語錄), criticizes blind-Chan people who talk up Linji and do nothing but stick-and-shout.

Occurrences.Kwic: 勉謬行棒喝者欲啟吾家棒喝門，好將棒喝看分明，棒須劈破有無見，喝要澄空迷悟情。迷悟空時星月朗，有無破處水山清，棒頭喝下如親切，是則名為棒喝人。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Meixi Fudu, in the Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Dongshan Meixi Du (東山梅溪度禪師語錄), heads and writes an exhortation to people who wrongly go about with stick-and-shout.

Occurrences.Kwic: 為謬認棒喝者呵斥棒喝。或有格外人來，不立根機，直提向上
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Baiyu (百愚禪師語錄): inside his hall speech, Baiyu Jingsi utters the headword in a parallel sequence rebuking those who mistakenly recognize blows and shouts.

Occurrences.Kwic: 至有纔著袈裟便行棒喝者。問之，則曰：臨濟宗也。臨濟宗固如是乎？
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Chan Gate Forge, complete letter-question: Yu Jisheng asks whether robe-wearers who immediately wield stick and shout truly represent the Linji school. Wuyi Yuanlai is the addressee, not the utterer.

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: 余集生冏卿問 introduces the entire question, including 纔著袈裟便行棒喝者.
ActorAttribution.ReviewedBy: Codex cohorts 1-3 v6 full-case hand read

Occurrences.Kwic: 認作棒喝，入地獄如箭射。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Faxi Yin (法璽印禪師語錄): Faxi Yin utters the recut reply criticizing recognition of the action merely as stick-blows and shouts.

Occurrences.Kwic: 棒喝交加，雷轟電掣，我等天子當持香華往修供養。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Tian'an Sheng, complete evening address: Tian'an constructs and voices the comic scene in which Indra hears 'stick-blows and shouts crossing.' Tian'an is the local utterer; Indra is the quoted figure within his address.
